title: Works most of the time. Sort of a pain to reassemble.
text:
Works most of the time. Sort of a pain to reassemble.. For the post part, it works well to remove cherry pits. Sometimes, the cherries stick to the prongs, which causes me to remove the cherry and try again.

Disassembling is easy to clean, but reassembling it takes three to four times as long.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Quick Release Multi Cherry Pitter
features: Releases pitted fruit directly into bowls for more cherries with less mess
Simply press and lift and up to six pitted cherries will fall directly into your bow
Easy-to-access tray catches pits for up to a pound of cherries at a tim
Adjustable base extends to fit a wide range of bowl sizes
Sturdy construction can withstand the busiest of cherry seasons
description: Make quick work of loads of cherries with the OXO Good Grips Quick-Release Multi-Cherry Pitter. This efficient pitter removes the stones from 6 cherries at a time and holds up to 1 pound of pits so you can prep pie, cobbler, clafoutis, fruit salad, or just a big bowl for snacking in a manner of minutes. The base adjusts to fit a wide range of bowls for pitting a little or a lot. Made for one-handed operation, there’s no need to remove the fruit after each round: When you lift the lid, the pitted cherries drop directly into the bowl while the pits are caught in an easy-to-access tray. The legs fold in for compact storage, and the pitter comes apart for thorough cleaning. Dishwasher safe.
